title: Stockpile — System
description: Is Stockpile up and healthy: pods, versions, traffic through the gateway, resources, its database and the background workers. The store's own numbers are on Stockpile — Store.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: Production (namespace batcave, database stockpile) or the shadow staging copy. The worker panels are production only: staging's workers aren't scraped.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Stockpile's alert rules (blookums prometheusrule.yaml) firing now. Production only.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Workers healthy: every worker's /healthz verdict (stockpile_worker_healthy).

panels.title: Heartbeat
panels.description: Worker heartbeat: since the oldest worker's self-checks last all passed.

panels.title: 5xx (1h)
panels.description: Server errors through the gateway, last hour.

panels.title: p95 (< 10 s)
panels.description: p95 latency over the last hour, gateway to Stockpile and back, of requests that finished within 10 s. The print helper's long polls (held ~25 s) would swamp it otherwise; requests held longer are on 'Held 10 s or more'.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, shop, channel, vendor, family, queue) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Stockpile.*"})

panels.title: Running images
panels.description: Every Stockpile pod, the image it runs, how long it has been up and its restarts.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$env", pod=~"stockpile-.+", pod!~".*-grants-.*"})

panels.title: Worker build
panels.description: What each worker says it is (stockpile_build_info).

panels.title: Database
panels.description: The shared Postgres cluster's instances: primary or replica, and each replica's lag. Grafana's Store queries read from a replica.

panels.title: Requests by service
panels.description: Requests the Cilium gateway sent to each Stockpile service.

panels.title: Error rate by service
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx (and 4xx). A few 4xx are normal: expired sessions, bots.

panels.title: Latency by service (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Of requests that finished within 10 s (the print helper's ~25 s long polls left out).

panels.title: Held 10 s or more
panels.description: Requests per minute that took 10 s or more. Each paired print helper long-polls ~2.4 a minute on the api; more than that is real slowness.

panels.title: In flight, timeouts and resets
panels.description: Requests open at the gateway (each print helper holds one), and upstream timeouts / connection resets per minute (a pod restarting mid-request shows here).

panels.title: Memory used of limit
panels.description: Working set over the memory limit. At 100% the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$env", pod=~"stockpile-.+", pod!~".*-grants-.*", container!=""}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$env", pod=~"stockpile-.+", pod!~".*-grants-.*", resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CPU periods a pod was held back by its CPU limit.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$env", pod=~"stockpile-.+", pod!~".*-grants-.*", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$env", pod=~"stockpile-.+", pod!~".*-grants-.*", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Received above the line, sent below.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open connections to this database on each instance.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: Per second, all instances (reads on the replicas count too).

panels.title: Queue backlog
panels.description: Jobs due and waiting for a worker, per queue.

panels.title: Oldest waiting job
panels.description: Store queues alert at 15 min, the rest at 2 h.

panels.title: Queues now
panels.description: Failed = failed jobs kept by the queue, not a running total.

panels.title: Who runs what
panels.description: Job families per worker, and which parts of each worker's metrics read cleanly on the last scrape.

panels.title: Distributor syncs
panels.description: Each distributor's catalog and quantity syncs: since the last success, the latest run's outcome, and a run still going.

panels.title: Shop pricing pulls
panels.description: Each shop's own distributor pricing pull (its dealer costs).

panels.title: Distributor stock freshness
panels.description: How far each distributor's stock counts are toward stale (100% = its offers count as stale).
